title: Community validation and distribution practices

sources.title: Built an OSS CI gate for Codex plugins

key_findings: A community scanner workflow has emerged around codex-plugin-scanner lint/verify and a GitHub Action gate before wider distribution.
The awesome-codex-plugins registry uses a real repo marketplace and mirrored plugin folders, matching the official marketplace shape.
Registry maintainers treat validation evidence, plugin metadata quality, and packaging cleanliness as part of publish readiness.
recommended_actions: Keep the repo marketplace machine-readable and checked into source control.
Validate manifest JSON and marketplace JSON after generating them.
Document the local marketplace install path so users can test the repo as a curated Codex source.
